sovereign_country.strategic_role: 拉美美元金融中枢、私人利益基金会（PIF）与运河船舶登记

business_scope.primary_industry_name: Ownership and Cross-Border Sub-Licensing of Trademarks and Patents

meta_jurisdiction_context.jurisdiction_name_en: Republic of Panama (unitary national jurisdiction; no sub-state tax distinction)
meta_jurisdiction_context.legal_system_doctrine: Hybrid - Civil Law (Romano-Germanic) with strong Common Law corporate, trust, and maritime law elements; corporations governed by Law 32 of 1927
applicable_bilateral_investment_treaties: US-Panama Trade Promotion Agreement (TPA, in force 31 October 2012) - includes investment protections and intellectual property chapter
Panama-United Kingdom Investment Promotion and Protection Agreement
US-Panama Tax Information Exchange Agreement (in force 2011)

ubo_and_aml_profiling.statutory_law_governance: Law No. 23 of 27 April 2015 (AML/CFT) as amended by Law 70 of 2019 and Law 254 of 2021; Law No. 52 of 27 August 2016 together with Law 23 of 2015 establishing the Superintendencia de Sujetos No Financieros (SSNF); Law No. 129 of 29 October 2020 (national Beneficial Owner Register); Executive Decree No. 170 of 17 May 2017 (customer due diligence); Law No. 47 of 2013 (bearer-share immobilization and owner identification); FATF Recommendations applicable through Panama's mutual evaluation follow-up process.

mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.document_name: Certified passport copies of all subscriber shareholders, directors, and ultimate beneficial owners
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.issuing_entity: Issuing national passport authority; notarized copy before a Panamanian notary
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.authentication_path: Hague Apostille (or consular legalization if country of origin is not an Apostille Contracting State)

mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.document_name: Certificate of Good Standing or corporate incumbency of any corporate shareholder or parent
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.issuing_entity: Home-country companies registry or licensed registered agent
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.authentication_path: Hague Apostille or consular legalization; certified Spanish translation if required

mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.document_name: Power of Attorney appointing the Panamanian incorporation agent and law firm
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.issuing_entity: Notary public in the country of origin or Panamanian notary
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.authentication_path: Hague Apostille or consular legalization; Spanish translation

mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.document_name: Bank reference letter and source-of-funds / source-of-wealth statement for ultimate beneficial owners
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.authentication_path: Notarization plus Hague Apostille or consular legalization

mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.document_name: Sworn declaration of final beneficiary (Declaracion Jurada de Beneficiario Final)
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.authentication_path: Domestic notarization and filing with SSNF / UBO register (no apostille required when executed in Panama)

ubo_and_aml_profiling.pep_and_sanctions_screening_protocols: Mandatory screening of all shareholders, directors, officers, UBOs, and known counterparties against the OFAC SDN List, UN Security Council Consolidated List, EU Consolidated Financial Sanctions List, UK Sanctions List, and the Panama national list maintained by the Unidad de Analisis Financiero (UAF). Enhanced Due Diligence, senior-management approval, and source-of-funds substantiation are required for all PEPs (domestic and foreign) and for transactions connected to high-risk jurisdictions, per FATF Recommendations 12 and 22 and Law 23 of 2015.

statutory_name_clearance_protocol.registry_portal_name: Registro Publico de Panama - online name search and reservation system ('Sistema de Busqueda y Reserva de Nombre') accessible via www.registropublico.gob.pa
statutory_name_clearance_protocol.language_and_transliteration_doctrine: The corporate name may be in any language provided it is written or transliterated in Latin script; it must be distinguishable from all existing registered names and may end with the token 'S.A.'; non-Latin scripts require an official phonetic transliteration. Names suggesting government sponsorship or regulated banking, insurance, trust, or securities activity are restricted; use of the word 'Panama' requires prior registry authorization.
prohibited_and_sensitive_tokens: Banco (prior authorization required from Superintendencia de Bancos)
Seguros / Reaseguros (prior authorization required from Superintendencia de Seguros)
Fondo de Inversion / Valores / Bolsa (prior authorization required from Superintendencia del Mercado de Valores)
Fideicomiso / Trust (regulated activity; requires licensing certification)
Panama / Republica de Panama (requires Registro Publico authorization)
Oficial / Gobierno / Municipal / Ministerio (misleading state implication)
Internacional (imposes minimum declared capital and additional documentary requirements)
statutory_name_clearance_protocol.extension_and_rejection_appeal_sop: Upon name rejection, the applicant may file a written 'recurso de reconsideracion' with the Direccion General of the Registro Publico de Panama within five (5) business days of notification, attaching the rejected name-search certificate and a supporting legal brief; in the same submission an 'apelacion en subsidio' may be lodged to the corresponding superior registry authority. Alternatively, a new name-search application may be filed immediately using secondary proposed names. Final administrative denials may be challenged before the Third Chamber (Contencioso-Administrativo) of the Corte Suprema de Justicia.

registered_office_and_commercial_substan.virtual_office_permissibility: Permitted at incorporation provided a licensed resident agent maintains a Panamanian registered address; however, Law 254 of 2021 (economic substance) requires a Panama tax-resident IP holding company to demonstrate local management, premises, employees, and decision-making substance. A fully virtual structure without local substance is acceptable only if the S.A. is managed and controlled abroad and files as a non-resident; substance documentation must still be maintained.
registered_office_and_commercial_substan.physical_inspection_likelihood: Moderate - estimated 12% to 15% annual probability of unannounced on-site inspections by SSNF or DGI for IP/licensing holding vehicles; probability rises to 25% or more where the registered office is a shared virtual address, where royalty flows involve high-risk jurisdictions, or where substance indicators are internally inconsistent.

pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.expense_line_item: Name search and reservation certificate (Certificado de Busqueda y Reserva de Nombre)
pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.legal_fee_basis: Official Registro Publico tariff schedule (Law 18 of 2006)

pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.expense_line_item: Legal drafting, notarization, and execution of articles of incorporation (Sociedad Anonima)
pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.charging_authority: Panamanian law firm and notary public
pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.legal_fee_basis: Prevailing market benchmark; Colegio Nacional de Abogados fee scale

pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.expense_line_item: Licensed resident agent services - first year
pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.legal_fee_basis: Market benchmark; mandatory requirement under Law 54 of 2016

pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.expense_line_item: Registered office address - first year (local physical or virtual address)

pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.legal_fee_basis: Official registration tariff for minimum capital bracket under Law 32 of 1927

pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.expense_line_item: Stamp tax on incorporation instruments (Impuesto de Timbre)
pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.legal_fee_basis: Codigo Fiscal stamp tax rate on notarized corporate instruments

pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.expense_line_item: Apostille and consular legalization of KYC/statutory documents
pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.charging_authority: Ministerio de Relaciones Exteriores (apostille) plus consulate fees where applicable
pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.legal_fee_basis: Official apostille schedule (approximately USD 35-50 per document) plus courier and translation disbursements

pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.expense_line_item: AML/KYC onboarding, UBO register filing, and record-keeping administration
pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.legal_fee_basis: Market benchmark; compliance obligations under Law 129 of 2020 and Law 23 of 2015

pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.expense_line_item: PEP and sanctions screening subscription (OFAC, UN, EU, UAF lists)
Courier, certified translations, and filing disbursements

incorporation_legal_framework.governing_statute_and_sections: Ley No. 32 de 26 de febrero de 1927 (Ley General de Sociedades Anónimas), as amended, Arts. 1, 2, 5, 28 and 52; complemented by Law No. 14 of 2007 (Digital Commerce) and Resolución No. 101-16 of the Registro Público for online incorporation.
incorporation_legal_framework.competent_registry_authority: Registro Público de Panamá – Sección de Personas Jurídicas (Registro Mercantil), one-stop electronic filing via the Panamá Emprende portal (panamaemprende.gob.pa).
incorporation_legal_framework.statutory_filing_instrument: Escritura Pública de Constitución (Public Deed of Incorporation) containing the Pacto Social y Estatutos of the Sociedad Anónima, executed before a Panamanian Notary and inscribed in the Public Registry.
incorporation_legal_framework.minimum_paid_up_capital_rule: No statutory minimum paid-up capital. Standard authorized capital is B/.10,000 (10,000 shares of par value B/.1.00 each); only one share must be subscribed. No escrow-deposit or capitalization account is required for unlicensed S.A.s; subscription price may remain unpaid until called by the Board.
incorporation_legal_framework.pro_forma_first_board_resolution_en:
RESOLVED: That the incorporator's report is approved and the subscription of Ten Thousand Balboas (B/.10,000), divided into ten thousand shares of B/.1.00 each, is ratified; share certificates shall issue upon payment.
RESOLVED: That the registered office is established at the office of [Resident Agent], Republic of Panama, which firm is appointed resident agent under Law 32 of 1927.
RESOLVED: That [President], [Secretary], and [Treasurer] are elected and appointed as officers for one year, with powers and duties prescribed in the Bylaws.
RESOLVED: That the President and Secretary, acting jointly, are authorized to execute agreements, open bank accounts, and file the patent licensing contracts.

step_by_step_formation_sop.step_name: Corporate name search, reservation, and resident agent engagement
step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: Registro Público de Panamá (online name-search module); Panamá Emprende one-stop portal
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: Verify the proposed corporate name for the patent-holding S.A. against the Registro Público's index of registered names; reserve the selected name (certificado de búsqueda / ficha) and concurrently execute a resident agent services agreement with a licensed Panamanian attorney or law firm, as mandated by Art. 5 of Law 32 of 1927.
required_dossiers: Three proposed corporate names in descending preference
Passport copies of each incorporator/shareholder
Foreign or local company registration evidence of the beneficial owner (where applicable)
Signed resident agent engagement agreement with AML/KYC questionnaire
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: If the name search returns a confusingly similar match, file a written reconsideration with a certified search report or adopt the next alternative name; the reservation fee is credited toward the final election.

step_by_step_formation_sop.step_name: Drafting and notarial execution of the Escritura Pública de Constitución
step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: Notaría Pública de la República de Panamá (digital notarial module via Panamá Emprende)
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: The resident agent drafts the Pacto Social y Estatutos, including: corporate name ending in 'S.A.', specific purpose of ownership and cross-border sub-licensing of patents and trademarks, authorized capital, resident agent clause, and board structure. The incorporators (or their authorized attorneys-in-fact) execute the deed before a notary; execution by digital signature is permitted under Law 14 of 2007.
required_dossiers: Draft Pacto Social y Estatutos approved by the incorporators
Notarized power of attorney for each remotely participating incorporator
Passport copies and tax identification of directors and officers
Name reservation certificate from the Registro Público
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: If the notary objects to a clause, the attorney amends the draft and the incorporators re-execute; procedural omissions are cured within three business days by lodging supplemental exhibits without re-payment of notarial fees.

step_by_step_formation_sop.step_name: Inscription of the Public Deed in the Public Registry (registro mercantil)
step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: Registro Público de Panamá – Sección de Personas Jurídicas / Registro Mercantil
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: File the Escritura Pública together with the filing sheet (hoja de inscripción) through the Panamá Emprende electronic system or at the registry counter; pay the applicable state incorporation fee (B/.850 package); await the inscription order, which grants the corporation separate juridical personality and legal existence effective from the deed date.
required_dossiers: Original Escritura Pública de Constitución
Filing sheet with signature and seal of the notary/attorney
Proof of payment of the registration fee
Copy of the resident agent's license issued by the Registro Público
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: If the Registry raises observations, correct the identified defects and resubmit within ten business days; the original filing fee is carried over to the corrected filing, avoiding any additional state charge.

step_by_step_formation_sop.step_name: Issuance of post-registration certificates and legalization of corporate books
step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: Registro Público de Panamá – Certification Office and Stamping Office (Legalización de Libros)
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: Upon inscription, obtain the Certificado de Persona Jurídica (incorporation certificate), the registered deed excerpt, and the official company ficha; acquire the corporate books (Libro de Acciones, Libro de Actas) and have them stamped by the Public Registry; record the share issuance and hold the organizational meeting of directors.
required_dossiers: Certificado de Persona Jurídica
Certified copy of the inscribed deed with registration annotation
Corporate books to be legalized (share register and minutes book)
Identification of directors for the minutes of the organizational meeting
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: If the books are rejected due to missing stamps, re-present them at the Stamping Office within five business days; no penalty applies for first-time corrections of un-stamped books.

step_by_step_formation_sop.step_name: Fiscal registration, beneficial ownership filing, and municipal operation notice
step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: Dirección General de Ingresos (DGI) – Ministerio de Economía y Finanzas; Registro de Beneficiarios Finales (Law 129 of 2020); Municipio de Panamá – Ventanilla Única del Aviso de Operación
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: Register the S.A. in the Registro Único de Contribuyentes (RUC) within 30 days of incorporation; file the Beneficiarios Finales (UBO) declaration identifying ultimate natural persons owning or controlling the company; if a physical representative office is maintained in Panama City, obtain the municipal Aviso de Operación under the category 'servicios de gestión y licenciamiento de propiedad intelectual'.
required_dossiers: Certificado de Persona Jurídica and registration ficha
Passports and residence data of directors/UBO
DGI Formulario de inscripción RUC
Lease or address proof of the representative office (for municipal aviso)
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: Late RUC registration attracts a nominal surcharge and is cured by payment plus electronic filing; UBO declarations are updated within 30 days of any change; DGI observations for missing backup documentation are cured within fifteen business days with Spanish sworn translations.

industry_physical_and_environmental_lice.competent_industrial_authority: Ministerio de Comercio e Industrias (MICI) – Dirección de Empresas y Licencias: no industrial or manufacturing license is applicable to a pure patent-holding and sub-licensing S.A.; the only administrative permit relevant to an office presence is the municipal Aviso de Operación of the local municipality (e.g., Municipio de Panamá).
industry_physical_and_environmental_lice.operating_license_title: Not applicable – the entity will not operate manufacturing or physical industrial facilities. Optional municipal 'Aviso de Operación' for branch-office presence in Panama; no sectoral operating permit required under ISIC 6420 / NAICS 533110.

environmental_impact_assessment_eia.agency_name: Ministerio de Ambiente (MiAMBIENTE) – Dirección de Evaluación de Impacto Ambiental (formerly ANAM)
environmental_impact_assessment_eia.classification_tier: Exempt / Category I (Registro Ambiental) – office-based IP licensing activities do not require a full or semi-detailed EIA Report under Decreto Ejecutivo No. 123 de 2009; only a Category I environmental registration is required if physical offices are occupied.
environmental_impact_assessment_eia.discharge_and_emissions_standards: None triggered for IP licensing operations. Office premises must comply with the Municipal Waste Management Ordinance for dry solid waste and, if applicable, the national VOC threshold of 20 tonnes/year (not triggered for office density); no wastewater discharge permits required for administrative use.

industry_physical_and_environmental_lice.civil_defense_and_occupational_clearance: Cuerpo de Bomberos de Panamá – fire safety inspection and issuance of the Certificado de Seguridad for the registered office; Ministerio de Trabajo y Desarrollo Laboral (MITRADEL) occupational health and workplace clearance where employees are present; structural load inspections are not applicable beyond the building's certified commercial occupancy.

national_tax_registration_infrastructure.competent_tax_authority: Dirección General de Ingresos (DGI) of the Ministerio de Economía y Finanzas (MEF), Republic of Panama; electronic hub: SITIO portal (Sistema Integrado Tributario de Información y Optimización) at https://dgi.mef.gob.pa; customs export platform: SIGA administered by the Autoridad Nacional de Aduanas (ANA).
national_tax_registration_infrastructure.tax_id_procurement_sop: (1) After incorporation at the Registro Público (public deed deposit and issuance of certified testimonio), the appointed fiscal resident agent (abogado idóneo) files the RUC registration form in SITIO or at DGI service windows, attaching: certified testimonio of the Escritura Pública, certificate of corporate existence, appointment of directors/officers, power of attorney of the resident agent, notarized fiscal address, and identity documents of directors and beneficial owners. (2) DGI issues the permanent RUC, which simultaneously registers the S.A. as the ITBMS taxpayer; the S.A. next obtains the municipal Aviso de Operación (operating license) from the district mayor (e.g., Municipio de Panamá). (3) The S.A. acquires a Firma Electrónica (digital certificate) from a DGI-authorized certifier to operate SITIO, file returns and issue e-invoices. (4) No local TIN is required for non-resident shareholders; the S.A. RUC covers all tax obligations, and the resident agent receives official service of process. Processing time: 3–7 business days upon complete submission.
national_tax_registration_infrastructure.default_entity_tax_classification: Territorial_Scope — the S.A. is an opaque entity-level taxpayer under the corporate income tax (ISR, flat 25%) but is taxable exclusively on Panama-source income: foreign-source royalties from patents/trademarks are outside the ISR base unless the IP is 'used or exploited' in Panama (Law 254 of 2021 economic-destination test). Dividends received from non-resident subsidiaries are exempt, and no participation-exemption or CFC regime applies to active licensing income.
national_tax_registration_infrastructure.statutory_election_mechanisms: No check-the-box or pass-through election exists: a Panamanian S.A. is per se a territorial, entity-level taxpayer. Statutory elections available: (a) election to exclude foreign-source licensing income from ISR and ITBMS by evidencing foreign economic destination under Law 254 of 2021 (sworn affidavit + supporting documentation filed in SITIO); (b) election of the Régimen Especial Simplificado (RES) for ITBMS, available where annual turnover ≤ B/.36,000, forfeited upon issuance of export invoices; (c) election of tax-neutral corporate reorganization treatment (Fiscal Code reorganization rules) subject to prior DGI approval; (d) no hybrid mismatch, participation exemption, or preferential royalty-regime elections exist.

indirect_taxation_nexus_and_rules.indirect_tax_system_name: ITBMS (Impuesto de Transferencia de Bienes Muebles y Servicios) — a single-stage VAT-type tax enacted by Law 8 of 2010 on transfers of movable goods, service rendering and goods importation, operating on invoices with input-tax credits (crédito fiscal). Patent/trademark licensing royalties paid by Panamanian licensees fall within taxable services unless zero-rated as exports.
indirect_taxation_nexus_and_rules.statutory_registration_threshold_local_c: No exemption threshold: any person engaged in taxable transfers of movable goods or services in Panama must register for ITBMS before commencement (RUC). A simplification threshold applies: taxpayers with annual gross income ≤ B/.36,000 may opt for the RES fixed-quota regime; exporters and withholding agents are mandatorily excluded from the RES.
indirect_taxation_nexus_and_rules.electronic_invoicing_and_clearance_manda: Mandatory e-invoicing (Factura Electrónica de Panamá) established by DGI Resolution No. 201-4324 of 21 October 2021 and phased by annual revenue: ≥ B/.36 million from January 2022; ≥ B/.3 million from January 2023; ≥ B/.600,000 from January 2024; and all remaining taxpayers from January 2025. Invoices are transmitted in real time as XML 'Set de Factura Electrónica' to the DGI SITIO platform, receive online validation (Aceptada/Rechazada), and must carry a QR code and acceptance code; issuance requires a valid Firma Electrónica and authorized e-invoicing software, with automatic fines and RUC suspension for recurring non-compliance.

export_zero_rating_and_refund_substantia.zero_rating_eligibility: Zero-rating applies to: (i) physical exports of goods evidenced by a DUA in the SIGA customs system; (ii) services rendered to non-residents for use or exploitation outside Panama under Law 8 of 2010; and (iii) IP licensing to a non-resident licensee where the patent/trademark is not used, protected or commercialized within Panama and the licensee has no Panamanian PE (Law 254 of 2021 territoriality test). Royalties must be paid from abroad (foreign bank/SWIFT), invoiced through e-invoicing, and the taxpayer must assemble the export evidence file; the corresponding ITBMS input credits are claimable by the exporter in the quarterly return, with a right to cash refund (reintegro) within the DGI's verification framework.
mandatory_customs_documentation_bundle: Customs export declaration (Declaración Única Aduanera – DUA) filed in the SIGA platform (required for goods; for pure IP licensing, substituted by the license agreement and DGI territoriality affidavit)
Bill of Lading or Air Waybill evidencing physical departure from Panamanian customs territory (goods only)
Inward Remittance Certificate (Comprobante de Ingreso de Divisas) issued by a licensed Panamanian bank, or SWIFT MT103/credit advice, evidencing inbound foreign-currency payment of the royalty
Signed and authenticated licensing agreement (with amendments, sub-licensing grants and foreign patent/registration certificates)
Factura Electrónica bearing the SITIO acceptance code
Sworn affidavit of the legal representative attesting to the licensee's non-resident status and the exclusive foreign use/exploitation of the licensed IP
export_zero_rating_and_refund_substantia.audit_scrutiny_and_clawback_penalties: DGI audit units (Large Taxpayers and E-Exports) apply a strict burden-of-proof standard in IP-export cases: failure to produce the documentation bundle recharacterizes the royalties as Panama-source income, voids the zero-rating, and triggers assessment of 7% ITBMS on gross royalties plus the omitted ISR (25%) with a monthly recargo of 1% per month or fraction and an administrative penalty of 10%–100% of the defrauded tax; any ITBMS refund previously paid is clawed back with interest, and export invoices unsettled beyond the 180-day repatriation window are recharacterized as Panama-source financing income. Where false invoices, simulated export documents or sham licenses are used, the conduct is prosecuted as fiscal fraud under Law 70 of 2019, carrying imprisonment of up to 6 years and fines of up to 100% of the tax evaded, with criminal liability extending to directors and legal representatives; parallel AML sanctions under Law 23 of 2015 and registry de-registration of the S.A. may also be imposed.

fx_control_regime_and_central_bank_regul.central_bank_authority: Panama does not maintain a central bank; monetary affairs are anchored by full dollarization. The banking and financial regulatory authority is the Superintendencia de Bancos de Panamá (SBP), and Banco Nacional de Panamá acts as the fiscal agent for the Republic of Panama.
fx_control_regime_and_central_bank_regul.currency_convertibility_assessment: Panama uses the US dollar as legal tender. There are no exchange controls on current account or capital account transactions; the balboa is a nominal currency unit tied at par to the USD and does not create separate convertibility restrictions. Profits, dividends, royalties, loan repayments, and proceeds of capital liquidation may be freely remitted abroad in USD without central bank approval. Banking-level practical barriers include AML/CFT source-of-funds review, economic substance documentation, and sanctions screening; these are not currency controls, but they require the IP HoldCo to maintain transactional transparency and a full compliance dossier.
fx_control_regime_and_central_bank_regul.export_proceeds_surrender_rules: Panama imposes no statutory export proceeds surrender or conversion requirements. There is no mandatory timeline for repatriation and no prescribed conversion ratio into local currency. Export or service proceeds, including royalty receipts from foreign licensees, may be retained in USD or any freely convertible currency. The SBP and commercial banks nevertheless require supporting commercial documentation and beneficiary identification for all inward credit operations under AML/CFT obligations.

tier1_domestic_commercial_banks.account_class: Operational Account and Capital Escrow Account
Capital Escrow Account and Collection Account

corporate_banking_onboarding_blueprint.fintech_emi_cross_border_viability: Low-Medium feasibility. Panama's banking law restricts deposit-taking and account-based treasury services to entities licensed by the Superintendencia de Bancos de Panamá; offshore digital EMIs cannot independently hold client funds or operate as payment settlement banks in Panama without a local fintech or banking authorization. Foreign EMIs may be used as onboarding or payment initiation gateways only if they partner with a licensed local bank or operate under a recognized Panama Fintech Law (as amended) sandbox approval. For a patent licensing treasury structure, an offshore EMI is not a compliant primary clearing rail due to significant regulatory uncertainty, shadow banking exposure, and enhanced SCR/OFC risk flags. A licensed Panamanian bank account with direct USD SWIFT access remains the legally reliable rail.
corporate_banking_onboarding_blueprint.physical_presence_and_kyc_interview_mand: Physical presence is generally mandated for non-resident corporations. Panamanian banks, aligned with SBP AML/CFT regulations, require at least one authorized signer and the ultimate beneficial owner or a validly appointed legal representative to appear in person for a compliance interview at account opening; fully remote onboarding is not a statutory right and is only available under bank-specific risk-based programs using high-assurance video identity verification, notarized powers of attorney, and apostilled corporate resolutions. For a Panama S.A. conducting global IP licensing, directors who are natural persons should plan to attend a KYC interview in Panama City or, if unavailable, delegate through a certified Panamanian legal counsel with a properly notarized and apostilled resolution and complete beneficial ownership disclosure.

critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.trigger_point: Non-operating IP HoldCo with intangible assets and no physical local workforce is flagged as a conduit or potential shell company.
critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.evidentiary_defense_dossier: Provide a full economic-substance file containing the registered office lease, local corporate administration agreement, board meeting minutes, patent/trademark registration certificates, a robust intercompany licensing agreement, transfer pricing documentation, and a narrative explaining the commercial management and enforcement functions performed from Panama.

critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.trigger_point: High-volume or high-value royalty inflows inconsistent with the company's declared staffing, office footprint, and financial capacity.
critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.evidentiary_defense_dossier: Submit audited financial statements, billing registers, sub-licensing contracts, royalty valuation reports, evidence of local professional service fees, payroll records, utility/office expenses, and a forecast of expected royalty receipts with transactional source documentation.

critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.trigger_point: Cross-border payments to or from jurisdictions considered high-risk for money laundering, tax evasion, or sanctions evasion, including payments routed through multiple intermediary banks.
critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.evidentiary_defense_dossier: Provide a complete beneficial ownership declaration under Panama's Legal Entities Law, valid passports of ultimate owners, notarized shareholder and board resolutions, bank reference letters from the sending bank, source-of-wealth documentation for the capital injection, and an analysis of end-beneficiary jurisdictions with underlying licensing contracts.

critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.trigger_point: Rapid round-tripping or immediate onward transfer of inbound royalty funds without clear commercial substance.
critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.evidentiary_defense_dossier: Deliver a board-approved treasury policy, cash-flow projections, underlying trademark/patent license agreements, an intercompany settlement memo, commercial invoices for sub-license fees, and a formal restricted-use agreement demonstrating that funds are disbursed only on contractually justified obligations.

cross_border_liquidity_and_clearing_rail.inbound_capital_injection_routing: Inbound capital injections are executed as USD-denominated SWIFT MT103 payments from the parent entity or investor to the Panama S.A.'s operational or capital escrow account at a licensed Panamanian bank. The remitter must designate a clear payment purpose such as 'Capital Injection', 'Shareholder Loan', or 'Royalty Prepayment' in the SWIFT transaction reference; the receiving bank applies SBP-compliant beneficial ownership verification and OFAC/sanctions screening. Panama does not require Exchange Control approval or a formal purpose code, but the transaction must be supported by a capital contribution agreement, corporate issuance resolution, or loan agreement, and the funds must ticket to the issuer's equity/liability accounts in the company's ledger.
cross_border_liquidity_and_clearing_rail.outbound_trade_disbursements: Outbound trade and royalty disbursements are cleared primarily via SWIFT MT103 or MT202 correspondent bank transfers in USD. For high-value or documentary trade transactions, a commercial letter of credit under SWIFT MT700 with a Panamanian advising/nominated bank may be used, especially when the counterparty requires bank payment undertaking. Panama's high-value USD clearing is channeled through New York correspondent relationships using CHIPS or Fedwire; local low-value clearing may settle via ACH through the Panamanian clearing house. The IP HoldCo should instruct its bank to include a direct reference to the underlying license agreement on each outward transfer to avoid sanctions-related freezes and to preserve source-of-funds traceability.
permissible_fx_hedging_instruments: Outright FX forwards (deliverable USD against EUR, GBP, CHF, CNY, CAD, and JPY) under an ISDA or bank Master Agreement
Non-Deliverable Forwards (NDFs) for restricted or low-liquidity currencies where the underlying license fees are settled in USD
Cross-currency interest rate swaps for matched intercompany loans or long-term royalty receivable streams
Plain-vanilla OTC currency options (USD put/call against ER currencies) used for budget-rate confirmation on material license contracts

annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.receiving_authority: Dirección General de Ingresos (DGI), Ministry of Economy and Finance
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deadline_window: Annually on or before 31 March for the preceding fiscal year
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.delinquency_sanctions: 10% late-payment surcharge plus monthly statutory interest; loss of good-standing certificate; five consecutive years of unpaid annual tax may trigger administrative strike-off by the Registro Público.

annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deliverable: Annual Corporate Income Tax / Informative Tax Return ('Declaración Jurada de Renta')
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.receiving_authority: Dirección General de Ingresos (DGI), Ministry of Economy and Finance
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deadline_window: On or before 31 March following the close of the fiscal year (fiscal year normally calendar year)
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.delinquency_sanctions: Late-filing statutory fines under the Código Fiscal, default interest and surcharges; restriction on obtaining tax clearance ('Paz y Salvo'); potential withholding of good-standing certificates.

statutory_audit_and_accounting_mandate.compulsory_audit_thresholds: No general statutory audit is imposed on a non-listed Sociedad Anónima solely by corporation law. An independent certified public accountant audit becomes mandatory only if (i) gross annual revenue or total assets exceed the Panama DGI large-taxpayer thresholds as determined by DGI resolution, commonly when gross annual revenue exceeds USD 1,000,000 or total assets exceed USD 2,000,000; (ii) the company is subject to a sectoral regulatory body such as the Superintendency of Banks, Insurance, or Securities; or (iii) the DGI expressly issues an audit notification requiring audited financial statements.
statutory_audit_and_accounting_mandate.governing_accounting_framework: International Financial Reporting Standards (IFRS) as adopted in Panama; IFRS for SMEs is permitted for non-public holding companies; local Panamanian GAAP may be accepted for private companies not classified as large taxpayers. Consolidation under IFRS applies if group financial statements are prepared.

corporate_registers_and_ubo_annual_confi.ubo_annual_confirmation_protocol: No public or annual UBO declaration is filed. The resident agent must maintain a current Beneficial Owner Register under Ley 70 de 2017 and re-confirm underlying natural persons by KYC update upon any share transfer or whenever a shareholder changes. Every share transfer must be recorded in the Share Register, supported by a board or shareholder resolution entered in the Minute Book. The resident agent must internally reconcile and audit the members, directors, beneficial owners, and minute book at least once per calendar year. The UBO register is confidential and is made available only to competent authorities upon lawful request.
mandatory_on_site_statutory_registers: Register of Beneficial Owners (maintained by resident agent under Ley 70 de 2017)

corporate_income_tax_regime.effective_tax_rate_incentives: Territorial taxation: patent royalties earned from exploitation outside Panama are exempt from corporate income tax as foreign-source income. Panama-source net taxable income is taxed progressively at 15% on the first B/.200,000 and 25% on the excess (Article 699 Código Fiscal). A minimum tax of 2% of net taxable income applies where it exceeds the regular tax (Arts. 698-A to 698-D CF). Preferential regimes include the Multinational Headquarters (SEM) regime granting 0% tax on foreign-source services, Panama Pacifico Special Economic Zone CIT exemption, and Ciudad del Saber incentives.
